EvaluationDetail.title: EvaluationDetail
EvaluationDetail.description: Compact campaign-level counters. Never carries inputs/outputs/explanations.

EvaluatorErrorDetail.title: EvaluatorErrorDetail
EvaluatorErrorDetail.description: The `detail` body of an evaluator error response — stable code + safe message.

EvaluatorErrorResponse.title: EvaluatorErrorResponse
EvaluatorErrorResponse.description:
The one canonical, truthful public error envelope: `{"detail": {...}}`.

`HTTPException(detail=EvaluatorErrorDetail(...).model_dump())` is what
Starlette actually serializes — this model documents that exact shape in
OpenAPI. Use it (not `EvaluatorErrorDetail` directly) in route `responses=`.

RuntimeAgentTarget.title: RuntimeAgentTarget
RuntimeAgentTarget.description:
Historical target kind — no longer accepted on creation (EVAL-04).

Kept only so `EvaluationCampaignResponse.target` can still render campaigns
created before EVAL-04 removed this path. Never used by
`CreateEvaluationCampaignRequest`, which is `ManagedInstanceTarget`-only.

TaskSummary.title: TaskSummary
TaskSummary.description: Lightweight current-state snapshot returned by GET /tasks.

TaskTarget.title: TaskTarget
TaskTarget.description: The object a task is operating on (document, user, database, …).
